text:
ivy: quick note — post qbringup there's a subtle regression in the promptset used for our rerank evals. noise on short clarifying prompts increased disagreement.

marc: saw that on the dashboard. disagreement spike around 09:15 UTC, mostly on the 1-2 sentence clarifiers. which quant/model?

ivy: distilled-qa-6b-int4 was in the sweep. baseline rdw-6b-int8 shows stable labels but distilled has more 'needs-clarification' votes.

dave: could this be a decoding default or EOS handling change? We forced params but distilled has a different termination bias.

lina: I pulled 120 affected pairs. pattern: distilled truncates earlier for multi-turn clarifiers, which causes labelers to mark 'incomplete context'. That raises disagreement.

label-ops: impact — annotator throughput drops ~10% and we're getting more soft labels. Pausing auto-queueing for rerank-clarifiers while you investigate.

ivy: mitigation idea: for rerank-only promptsets, pin model to control or run a short synthetic augmentation: replicate clarifiers with appended sentinel token to force termination parity. cheap and reversible.

marc: before workaround, let's run a quick audit: 200-sample paired relabel between control and distilled, tag cases where distilled output differs only by trailing tokens vs semantic change.

dave: script to extract pairs:
```
python tools/export_pairs.py --bench rerank-qbringup-6212 --filter clarifier --min-disagree 0.25 --out /tmp/6212_pairs.json
```
I'll run embed-sim for outputs to separate surface vs semantic diffs.

lina: I ran embed checks on a small slice: control/exp output embed cosine >0.98 in ~70% of diffs, suggesting surface-level changes.

label-ops: good. we'll stand up an adjudication job for the 200 sample audit; hold rerank clarifier campaigns in the meantime.

ci-bot: ticket created: INF-6120 (rerank-clarifier-adjudication), INF-6121 (eos-normalization-gate)

ivy: applied temporary routing change: distilled-qa removed from rerank-clarifier route, still allowed for general generation tests. Will queue audit manifest in 10m.

marc: follow-ups: 1) add eos-consistency and embed-sim checks to qbringup gating for rerank-sensitive promptsets, 2) experiment with sentinel token shim in curation for clarifiers, 3) run larger 1k-sample audit if the 200-sample adjudication shows systematic bias.

label-ops: manifest uploaded -> manifests/rerank_clarifier_audit_6212340000.json, job ADJ-9012 queued. We'll report adjudication results here.

ivy: quick end note — if audit flags many 'surface-only' diffs, we'll prefer a curation-level normalization over model routing changes. thanks team. :thumbsup:
